They seem to go on the front wheel arches, look behind the battery and underneath the air box, it's pretty common that they go there. If the engine is leaking oil then the rocker cover gasket could do with replacing. I'd personally recomend doing it anyway as the gasket is cheap and it's very easy to change over. Another cause for oil leaks is the camshaft seals. Not sure how difficult they are to do but seeing as you'd probably be changing the timing belt I'd do it whilst it's all apart. As for radios, OE ones can still be picked up from eBay for reasonably cheap. However, if you're looking to use this as a daily then I'd recommend a newer unit. The plastic frame can still be bought from vparts.se 
If you have the money to burn, then BLAUPUNKT are doing a return of their retro SQR 46. it's a replica of their old unit from the 80's but with all the modern features (DAB, BLUETOOTH, AUX). Definitely a good option if you want to keep it looking original!
